scientific_question: Does the functionally useful 64-stage c_proj connectivity selected from an exact dense-Muon direction lose task-effective capacity before the current 60-update refresh boundary, and if so is the first defensible shorter cadence 30 or 15 updates?

rejected_reuse.candidate: combine the existing per-update c_proj trajectory with the phase-boundary optimizer-state replay
rejected_reuse.reason: the tensors are bit-identical only at initialization and diverge afterward, so the combined trajectory would not be coherent

performance_gate.coverage: 60 real dense-Muon updates with all 60 profiler rows retained, optimizer probes at 0,15,30,45, and all-parameter snapshots at 0,15,30,45,60; evaluation time is subtracted, optimizer-probe serialization is inside iter_ms, and snapshot serialization is explicitly amortized into effective iteration time
performance_gate.denominator: same-GPU empirical BF16 tensor-core GEMM peak
performance_gate.failure_policy: do not launch the 238-update coherent replay if measured I/O-inclusive MFU is below 20 percent

analysis.focused_tests: 20/20 cadence, functional-metric, MFU, and trajectory tests passed before registration
analysis.candidate: 64-stage hidden-side Givens connectivity selected causally from the exact phase-start Muon direction
analysis.future_scoring: at each future probe, refit only diagonal Givens angles to the exact future Muon direction while keeping phase-start connectivity frozen; compare with freshly selected stage64 connectivity at that same future step
functional_metrics: post-GELU residual-output positive-line recovery on two disjoint fixed validation windows
recorded training-gradient positive predicted CE decrease
holdout validation-gradient positive predicted CE decrease
fixed-batch finite-step CE difference between aged and fresh connectivity
analysis.causality: future directions can refit angles and score a phase-start connectivity but cannot alter that connectivity

decision_rule.registered_retention_metric: minimum of aged/fresh post-GELU output positive-line recovery, recorded-training-gradient positive descent, and holdout-validation-gradient positive descent
decision_rule.r60_connectivity_not_stale: age-60 registered retention is at least 0.90
decision_rule.qualify_r30_performance_preflight: age-30 retention is at least 0.90 and age-45 or age-60 retention is below 0.80
decision_rule.qualify_r15_performance_preflight: age-15 retention is at least 0.90 and age-30 retention is below 0.80
decision_rule.otherwise: mixed cadence signal; no shorter-refresh training promotion

execution_policy.gpu: one otherwise idle GPU other than GPU0
execution_policy.mode: direct foreground execution and polling to exit

authorized: one 238-update coherent dense diagnostic replay if the preflight passes
one no-training chart-staleness analysis on that replay
not_authorized: a shorter-refresh language-model candidate before the staleness decision
